bead.title: Record hybrid load and recovery evidence
bead.description: Add and run hybrid performance evidence for multi-million-member campaign reshape/report scenarios. Provide smoke-safe defaults plus ignored release-tier commands. Compare objectlog/hybrid to objectlog/inmemory and objectlog/sqlite under the same segment config. Record push throughput, p50/p95/p99 ack latency, claim/finalize p95 latency, segment density/object PUT count, normal restart hydrate+tail time, tail length, and disk-loss exact reconstruction. Enforce gates from the plan: hot path within 20% of objectlog/inmemory where specified; 100k smoke recovery <=5s and <=1000 tail commands; 10M release-tier recovery <=60s and tail <=max(10000, 0.1% resident). Publish evidence under docs/perf/.
bead.acceptance:
1. Hybrid smoke performance command passes and writes docs/perf hybrid evidence.
2. Hybrid release-tier command for 10M resident items passes or records an explicit blocker with raw logs.
3. rg -n "objectlog/hybrid|10M|recovery|p99|segment" docs/perf finds the evidence.
4. cargo test --workspace --all-features passes.
5. cargo fmt --check passes.
